t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The number of mushrooms each forest has increases and decreases depending on which gnomes are selected and when. Green, yellow and orange are one set.

vb_textbox.text: There are 2 different forests, the yellow, orange, green and blue gnomes take you to one forest while the other 4 take you to another, as you collect from one forest the rewards will steadily decrease until you swap to another which should have more mushrooms than the forest you've been collecting from, swap between both for the most mushrooms.
